metrics.label: Runs at his man
metrics.desc: Attacking take-ons attempted per 90. Attempts, not completions — trying is the trait that repeats.

metrics.label: Beats his man
metrics.desc: Share of take-ons completed. Noisier than the attempt rate; treat gently.

metrics.label: Overruns it
metrics.desc: Take-ons where he ran the ball too far, per 90.

metrics.label: Loses it
metrics.desc: Dispossessed per 90 — tackled out of possession while carrying.

metrics.label: Carries into the box
metrics.desc: Take-ons completed inside the penalty area per 90.

metrics.label: Key passes
metrics.desc: Passes that directly set up a shot, per 90.

metrics.label: Big chances created
metrics.desc: Passes that created a chance Opta rates as big.

metrics.label: Passes into the box
metrics.desc: Completed passes finishing inside the penalty area, per 90.

metrics.label: Crosses
metrics.desc: Crosses attempted per 90.

metrics.label: Crosses that find a man
metrics.desc: Share of crosses completed — delivery quality rather than volume.

metrics.label: Through balls
metrics.desc: Passes played through the defensive line.

metrics.label: Progressive passes
metrics.desc: Completed passes moving the ball meaningfully up the pitch.

metrics.label: Into the final third
metrics.desc: Completed passes entering the final third.

metrics.label: Switches of play
metrics.desc: Long passes that change the side of the pitch.

metrics.label: Long balls that stick
metrics.desc: Completion rate of long passes.

metrics.label: On the ball
metrics.desc: Passes attempted per 90 — involvement, not quality.

metrics.label: Keeps it
metrics.desc: Pass completion. Flattered by safe, short passing.

metrics.label: Touches in the box
metrics.desc: Any touch inside the opposition penalty area.

metrics.label: Duels
metrics.desc: Aerials, tackles and challenges contested per 90 — how often he competes.

metrics.label: Duels won
metrics.desc: Share of contested duels won.

metrics.label: Defensive headers
metrics.desc: Aerial duels contested while defending. Not available from free sources before events.

metrics.label: Defensive headers won
metrics.desc: Win rate in defensive aerial duels.

metrics.label: Attacking headers
metrics.desc: Aerial duels contested while attacking.

metrics.label: Attacking headers won
metrics.desc: Win rate in attacking aerial duels.

metrics.label: Tackles
metrics.desc: Tackles attempted per 90.

metrics.label: Tackles won
metrics.desc: Share of tackles that won the ball.

metrics.label: Reads the game
metrics.desc: Interceptions per 90 — being where the pass was going.

metrics.label: Clearances
metrics.desc: Clearances per 90. High for deep defences; read with the team in mind.

metrics.label: Wins it back
metrics.desc: Loose balls recovered per 90.

metrics.label: Last-man tackles
metrics.desc: Tackles made as the last defender.

metrics.label: Defends high
metrics.desc: Average pitch position of his defensive actions (0 = own goal line, 100 = theirs).

metrics.label: Fouls
metrics.desc: Fouls conceded per 90.

metrics.label: Cards
metrics.desc: Bookings per 90 (a red counts as three).

metrics.label: Errors
metrics.desc: Mistakes Opta flags as leading to a shot. Rare, so unreliable over a single season.

metrics.label: Gets fouled
metrics.desc: Fouls won per 90 — carries into contact.
